questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given in jumbled order. Arrange them in the correct order to form a meaningful paragraph. A. However, their population is declining nowadays due to noise pollution. B. It is one of the most common birds along with the other two species, the European starling and the rock pigeon. C. Their constant presence outside our homes makes it easy to overlook them. D. House sparrows can be found in most places with and without houses (or other structures).
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given in jumbled order. Arrange them in the correct order to form a meaningful paragraph.

A. However, their population is declining nowadays due to noise pollution.

B. It is one of the most common birds along with the other two species, the European starling and the rock pigeon.

C. Their constant presence outside our homes makes it easy to overlook them.

D. House sparrows can be found in most places with and without houses (or other structures).
questions.solution:
The correct order follows a logical flow of information:

• D (Introduces house sparrows and their widespread presence)

• B (Describes their commonality with other species)

• C (Talks about how they are often overlooked)

• A (Mentions their declining population due to pollution)

Thus, the correct order is DBCA.
